requirement.functional.name: OrderService
requirement.functional.@statement: Every placed order is recorded before payment is attempted
requirement.functional.@violation: A payment attempted against an order that was never stored

requirement.functional.name: OrderRecord
requirement.functional.@statement: An order records what was bought and for how much
requirement.functional.@violation: An order row that cannot say who placed it

requirement.functional.name: TranscribableReference
requirement.functional.@statement: An order carries a reference a customer can read down a phone line
requirement.functional.@violation: A reference that is a raw uuid

requirement.functional.name: OrderTimer
requirement.functional.@statement: An unpaid order expired on a wall-clock timer
requirement.functional.@violation: An order cancelled by elapsed time rather than by the customer

requirement.architectural.name: UuidPrimaryKeys
requirement.architectural.@statement: Every entity has a uuid primary key
requirement.architectural.@violation: An entity keyed by a composite string

requirement.architectural.name: SoftDeleteEverywhere
requirement.architectural.@statement: Every table carried a soft-delete flag rather than deleting rows
requirement.architectural.@violation: A hard delete on a table that promised its rows were recoverable
